say:28:1710102025:1.text: *sigh* Savannah... that place is full of red tape.
say:28:1710102025:1.source_cn: 啧啧，赛凡纳啊……那个全是繁文缛节的地方。

say:29:1710102026:1.text: I'll pass. Dressing up in stiff suits and fake socializing with strangers isn't my thing.
say:29:1710102026:1.source_cn: 您还是饶了我吧，我这人自在惯了，实在不习惯穿着紧绷绷的...

say:29:1710102026:1.female: I'll pass. Dressing up in stiff suits and fake socializing with strangers isn't my thing.

say:32:1710102028:1.text: Well, Savannah is the home turf of <style="highlight">the Solitaries</style>, my compatriots.

choice_prompt:33:1710102028.source_cn: 赛凡纳可是<style=highlight>隐士</style>——也就是我另一群同事们的老巢。

say:34:1710102029:1.text: Exactly, and that's why I know it like the back of my hand.
say:34:1710102029:1.source_cn: 正因为是，所以我才更清楚他们的手段。

say:35:1710102031:1.text: Make sure you keep your secrets under wraps before you head out.
say:35:1710102031:1.source_cn: 您这一去，可得把自己的秘密藏好了。
say:35:1710102031:1.male: Make sure you keep your secrets under wraps before you head out.
say:35:1710102031:1.female: Make sure you keep your secrets under wraps before you head out.

say:36:1710102032:1.text: If not, those folks will find out everything about your life, down to the color of your underwear, before you even set foot in Savannah.
say:36:1710102032:1.source_cn: 否则，恐怕您还没进城，那群人连您内衣的颜色，都记录在案了。

say:38:1710102033:1.source_cn: 那我就放心了。祝您好运，梅林大人。

say:39:1710102035:1.text: Anyway, I admire your courage in taking the harder path. I'll just stay here and enjoy the rest of my vacation.
say:39:1710102035:1.source_cn: 既然您决定要去受苦，那我就在这里继续享受我的假期了。
say:39:1710102035:1.male: Anyway, I admire your courage in taking the harder path. I'll just stay here and enjoy the rest of my vacation.
say:39:1710102035:1.female: Anyway, I admire your courage in taking the harder path. I'll just stay here and enjoy the rest of my vacation.

say:40:1710102036:1.text: Have a safe trip! If you come across any nice drinks, don't forget to bring some back for me.
say:40:1710102036:1.source_cn: 一路顺风。要是遇到什么好酒，别忘了给我捎两瓶。
say:40:1710102036:1.male: Have a safe trip! If you come across any nice drinks, don't forget to bring some back for me.
say:40:1710102036:1.female: Have a safe trip! If you come across any nice drinks, don't forget to bring some back for me.

say:42:1710102037:1.text: You shake your head in resignation. Then, you take out a quill and write a brief reply for Dolly to deliver.

say:44:1710102038:1.male: I'll send out your reply right away.
say:44:1710102038:1.female: I'll send out your reply right away.

narration:45:1710102039:0.female: A week later, you arrive at Savannah, the royal capital of the Lightbearer Empire.

narration:46:1710102040:0.text: As your carriage comes to a stop, the clamorous voices of the crowd fill your ears. It is the first day of the Ascension Festival.

say:48:1710102034:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，明智的选择。毕竟，我也是这浑水里的一条鱼啊。

choice:37:1:2.text: Maybe I should stay away from you first.
choice:37:1:2.source_cn: 看来我也得离你远一点
choice:37:1:2.male: Maybe I should stay away from you first.
choice:37:1:2.female: Maybe I should stay away from you first.

choice:33:0:1.text: So, it's your home turf too?
choice:33:0:1.male: So, it's your home turf too?
choice:33:0:1.female: So, it's your home turf too?

say:49:1710102030:0.text: I just don't like people snooping around my business.
say:49:1710102030:0.source_cn: 我只是不喜欢被人刺探隐私。

choice:33:1:2.text: Your tone doesn't sound that friendly...
choice:33:1:2.male: Your tone doesn't sound that friendly...
choice:33:1:2.female: Your tone doesn't sound that friendly...

choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 维伦，要不要陪我走一趟？

choice:20:0:1.text: I agree with what the letter says.
choice:20:0:1.male: I agree with what the letter says.
choice:20:0:1.female: I agree with what the letter says.

say:50:1710102020:0.text: Cassadee has started serving in the royal court, where turmoil never sleeps. Maybe it's time to check on her.
say:50:1710102020:0.source_cn: 科丝蒂在那个复杂的宫廷里任职，确实让你有些挂念，去看看...
say:50:1710102020:0.male: Cassadee has started serving in the royal court, where turmoil never sleeps. Maybe it's time to check on her.
say:50:1710102020:0.female: Cassadee has started serving in the royal court, where turmoil never sleeps. Maybe it's time to check on her.

choice:20:2:3.text: A festival? I could use a little break.
choice:20:2:3.male: A festival? I could use a little break.
choice:20:2:3.female: A festival? I could use a little break.

choice:9:1:2.text: This is our way of getting along.
choice:9:1:2.male: This is our way of getting along.
choice:9:1:2.female: This is our way of getting along.

choice:9:2:3.text: It just bothers me to see him resting all the time.
choice:9:2:3.source_cn: 我只是看不惯他一直在休息
choice:9:2:3.male: It just bothers me to see him resting all the time.
choice:9:2:3.female: It just bothers me to see him resting all the time.

choice:6:0:1.text: You've got an excuse for everything...
choice:6:0:1.source_cn: 你这借口真是越来越多了……
choice:6:0:1.male: You've got an excuse for everything...
choice:6:0:1.female: You've got an excuse for everything...

say:51:1710102005:1.text: My hands are meant for holding wine glasses and the hands of beautiful ladies, alright? If I start hauling timber, they'll end up with calluses...
say:51:1710102005:1.source_cn: 这可是一双用来握酒杯以及牵美丽小姐的手，要是去搬木头磨...

say:52:1710102006:1.text: That would be a major loss to Holistone, and possibly to the whole Lightbearer Empire!
say:52:1710102006:1.source_cn: 那可是圣石镇乃至耀光的大损失！

choice:3:1:2.text: You'd change your tune if I invited you to the tavern.
choice:3:1:2.male: You'd change your tune if I invited you to the tavern.
choice:3:1:2.female: You'd change your tune if I invited you to the tavern.

say:53:1710102007:1.text: Tsk, a vacation is about relaxing, not about how long it lasts.
say:53:1710102007:1.source_cn: 啧啧，休假是一种心态，不在于时间的长短。

say:54:1710102008:1.text: Mental recuperation requires physical rest as well, so I'll refrain from labor for now.
say:54:1710102008:1.source_cn: 我现在正处于身心疗愈期，严禁任何形式的体力劳动。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1710201008:.text: Means he did something incredible before we were born!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710201008:.source_cn: 发生在我们还没出生的时候的事情！
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710201008:.male: Means he did something incredible before we were born!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1710201008:.female: Means she did something incredible before we were born!
